package.name: livox_sdk2_vendor
package.description: Builds and installs Livox-SDK2 (pinned in deps.repos, tag v1.3.1) into the workspace prefix. Livox-SDK2 is plain CMake with no package.xml, so colcon cannot build it directly; livox_ros_driver2 find_library()s liblivox_lidar_sdk_shared.so and find_path()s livox_lidar_api.h, both of which this package puts on CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH. Upstream's own instructions install to /usr/local, which this machine cannot do (no sudo) and which would escape the pinned-workspace discipline anyway.
